notes.title: Avaria Hotfix: 07282020 (Gallery adjustments and more!)
notes.content:
Note that some of the fixes will require revering to an earlier save file due to the nature of the bugs and their fixes. 

Bug Fixes 

-Steam Achievement : “Its getting hot down there!” Should trigger now if doing the scene now.
-Gallery Tags should no longer be visible when viewing scenes. 

-NPC should no longer appear the next day after finishing Bar Quest shift
-Fixed Softlock if you try to go upstairs before talking to Brothel receptionist. 

Dialogue fixes

-Prostitution Introduction NPC should no longer display image glitch upon talking to again.
-NPC should disappear when completing bar quest at day and night time.

Gallery Fixes

-Some scenes were teleporting players, that has been fixed.
-Some Images were not disappearing properly upon completion
-Scene labels will no longer appear on top of scenes being viewed.
-Hints will display on scenes not unlocked yet.
-If you have not unlocked a scene, hints on where they are should now appear in their place.
-All Story Sex Scenes should now be unlocked upon defeating the final boss.

Brothel Fixes


-Scenes should now properly play and will be added to gallery upon completion.

notes.title: Avaria Hotfix: 07272020 (Mines glitch has been fixed!)
notes.content:
Previous hotfix prevented players from entering the mines at the start of the game. This has been addressed!


Again thank you guys for the support and the emails we are getting. The devs at Panic Machine are very appreciative of the help. This has not scared them off at all. In fact now they know full on well that Steam can deliver amazing performance. Despite the slip up they have been convinced.

Expect to see more of Shiory's art very very soon. A lot of it. Not just for this game! But others in the future... >:)

We are still addressing things reported, but this should solve the current game breaking buts. We appreciate your patience while we sort these issues and apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Avaria Hotfix: 07272020 (We are awake now!)
notes.content:
Note that some of the fixes will require revering to an earlier save file due to the nature of the bugs and their fixes.

Bugs Fixed:

- Steam Achievement : “Its getting hot down there!” will now activate on masterbation scene

- Fixed potion prices

- Quest Journal Guild Quest 3 : Description for quest was not displaying properly. Should now display the remaining quests needed to complete the quest. 

- Combat Nerfs : Combat throughout the entire dungeon has been addressed. Enemies don't hit as hard now. 

- Gallery scene fading out and not fading back in. 

- Dungeon 3 Slime boss loop : Being stuck in doing the Dungeon Slime boss repeatedly. 

- Hearts showing up after having sex with “Pink Haired Guy” 

We are still addressing things reported, but this should solve the current game breaking buts. We appreciate your patience while we sort these issues and apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Bug fixes, Free post release content plans, and translations!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37320936/e5526648d2153d2d9929a58b799445d95a850ade.jpg

Day 1 Bug fixes!

-Goblins in dungeon 1 have been nerfed. We accidentally made them too strong.

- People have been getting locked out of the game at the Golemn Prime boss. This has now been fixed.

- Steam overlay is affecting the FPS  drops in the game. Please turn it off or run less programs. We are investigating this issue further and are looking for resolutions that are more convenient. 

Post Release plans!

While we were able to get everything inside of the game that was in the original build. We and Panic Machine still have post release plans in store for you.

For those of you that are loving the dark skin beauty Ameila expect much more  content with her in the the future as well as more additions. This is all in preparation for the international update of this game game where translations will be added! 

thank you everyone for your support. And please if you are enjoying what we are doing and enjoy the games we put out. Make sure to leave a review! Take care guys... we are going to sleep for real this time after little sleep for 4 days.

Oh...

That's right...

This comes out tomorrow...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226640/Pieces_of_my_Heart/

...

Well so much for sleep!

notes.title: Annnd we fucking did it! Avaria is now out!
notes.content:
Instead of delaying the game for another month. Fiends pitched in and we managed to get 1 months of work in 4 days! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37320936/a997b6e2a92a20e142ab5a4d3516ad6bacf4aeeb.png

Sorry for missing out on our launch window again and keeping you guys semi in the dark. We put all of our focus and energy on releasing the title. And we didn't want any distractions. 

But through fire and brimstone we were able to get this title finally out to you hands!

Some sleepless nights was had for the past 5 days as we ESSENTIALLY had to rebuild the game from the ground up. Despite this we apologize for the disjointed release. While we have been very successful in our publishing endeavors we are still new to the game of publishing and that means challenges that we have to face head on when they come up.

Instead of delaying the game for another month. Fiends pitched in and we managed to get 1 months of work in 4 days! Thanks for you patience.


****

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37320936/75bacd08d0d7b292ac73be278755bccdff8b4825.png

For those of you experiencing slow down this may be due to steam's overlay. We are currently looking into other solutions but if it becomes to much of an issue for many we may temporarily disable to smooth out your experience. We are going to take a WELL NEEDED NAP! But we will be immediately on standby if there are any issues after we wake up.

notes.title: Sigh... we tried... we really did.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37320936/3f82eaea3fc83e760448d0fb18f344a306462d4c.png

So we busted our balls for the past 24 hours to fix one big bug that sprawled into may other things.

We can't keep these guys awake any longer and they need to rest so they can be clearheaded to spear head this issues in the morning. We have contacted steam support to a lot us a bit more time as well (and no its not their fault stuff got delayed. They are innocent guys we promise.)

We will be working for 48 hours straight with some extra help to get things prepared. Sadly relatively simple projects can also just... not work the way you want them too. :U

We could release it right now, but we can't in good conscious do that. Its against our standards to do so. Give us until Fridays guys please. Avaria isn't meant to be anything groundbreaking but its important for us to give this particular developer and artist the confidence that they can continue in this field and be successful. And for us that means making the hard choices even if it going to upset people.

We'll see you guys in 48 hours. If things go good after the team wakes up, we might even be able to get it out sooner. But please give us until Friday night PST time!

Thanks again for understanding~

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37320936/a997b6e2a92a20e142ab5a4d3516ad6bacf4aeeb.png

notes.title: Avaria: Chains of Lust to release on July 22nd!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37320936/3f82eaea3fc83e760448d0fb18f344a306462d4c.png

The time has come!

As some of you noticed we had originally planned on getting this game released in April, but some things happened. What was it?

Well... its simple really. 

Polish!

Did Avaria needed to have custom sprites done? Maybe not.
Did Avaria need to have a custom music and sfx? Prob not.
Did Avaria needed to have partial voice acting? Nah...

BUT WE DID IT ANYWAY!

Even for relatively simple projects like this one if we feel like we can help the dev add some extra spice to that meal that they cooked up for you guys then we will always be there. We assisted Panic Machine the entire way during development and despite some rough beginnings we were able to help them and  Shiory get this to the finish line.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37320936/7929f59da0cc52ada5d50b0395c285dd24c62c97.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37320936/f4401dcff12ee9e9088ce473b0f8760f81f5f9c7.png

We are also very picky about release dates. With how congested Steam can get we have to be careful with dates to make sure we get devs the maximum amount of exposure possible on the platform. This dev decided to skip dlsite and head straight to Steam with their first release so its are job to prove to the dev how lucrative Steam can be under our brand.

Avaria: Chains of Lust will be releasing with a 11.99$ price tag with a 10% discount on launch. There is additional free DLC content planned as well as post-release support. 

Thank you all for your patience! We look forward... oh but before we go...

Translations

One thing that won't make it is being able some of the translations we wanted on release. We at Critical Bliss plan and sticking to our promise of providing as much international support as possible however. Similar to what happened to Last Evil, we will be rolling out translations post-release! So just be patient!

In the future our translation scheduling will improve greatly with more access to resources and talent. We will make sure of that. Thanks for the support! 

See you soon~

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37320936/273dfa50cb5ad4524db9d1ed1ee630352a22b800.png
